name: validate_addin

description.what: Checks a built add-in against the four causes that get submissions rejected.
description.when: Use before packaging or submitting, and after any manifest or entitlement change.
description.whenNot: Not for building. Call build_all_versions first if no output exists yet.
requires: A completed build for at least one target version
description.onPartialSuccess: Returns every finding it can reach even if one check errors. Surface the warnings array rather than reporting a clean run.

blastRadius: None. Reads files and makes one outbound HTTP HEAD request.
